page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules. Link a skill to an agent and it goes into that agent's prompt.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill, or import one from a file, a URL or the community catalog.

noMatch.title: No matching skills
noMatch.body: Try another search or type filter.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

menu.fileTooLarge: The file is too large to import (max {mb} MB).

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is Markdown text that goes into the prompt of every agent that links it.
create.defaultBody:
Flag … when …

- Point to the exact line.
- Explain why it matters.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameError: Use a kebab-case slug: lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (max {max}).
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag new branches that have no assertion.
fields.descriptionHint: The skill's interface: one directive sentence saying when it applies, e.g. 'Flag new branches that have no assertion.' The model sees it above the body.
fields.bodyHint: The text sent to the model, under the skill's name and description.

importUrl.title: Import from URL
importUrl.subtitle: An https:// link to a Markdown file or a .zip archive. GitHub blob links work too.
importUrl.label: URL

community.title: Community skills
community.subtitle: A vetted catalog shipped with DevDigest. Nothing is fetched from the internet.

empty.title: No matching skills
empty.body: Try a different search or tag.

importPreview.title: Review before importing
importPreview.trust: A skill is instructions injected into your agents' prompts. Only import skills you have read and trust. Imported skills are saved disabled. Enable one after reviewing it.

imported.banner: Imported from {ref}. Read it before enabling: it becomes instructions in your agents' prompts.

delete.title: Delete skill
delete.body: Delete "{name}"? Its versions go too. This cannot be undone.
delete.linked: It is linked to these agents, which will lose it:

editor.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this skill. Leave anyway?

config.title: Configuration
config.stale: Someone saved a newer version. Your draft is kept; save again to overwrite it.
config.dangerBody: Deleting a skill removes it from every agent that links it.

preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it

versions.title: Version history · {count, plural, one {# version} other {# versions}}
versions.caption: A new version is saved whenever the body or the description changes. Restore writes an old version as a new one.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? It is saved as a new version.
versions.restoreDirty: Save or cancel your changes before restoring.
versions.showDiff: Show diff against the current version
versions.noDiff: Same text as the current version.

stats.title: Last {days} days
stats.pullRateHint: {cited} of {attached} runs with this skill produced a finding citing it.

empty.title: No stats yet
empty.body: Stats accumulate from review runs. Link this skill to an agent and run a review.
